description: GlobTraceX is an Earth-system trend investigation platform developed by Team Protichamp for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It helps users explore environmental changes using NASA Earth-observation data, visualize trends, analyze their magnitude and statistical significance, and compare geographic regions and environmental signals. By connecting scientific analysis with clear visualizations and traceable data sources, GlobTraceX aims to turn complex Earth data into understandable, evidence-based insights.
